breakpoints.purpose: Configuration.screenWidthDp >= 840 selects horizontal panes; smaller widths stack the cards.

units.geometry: dp converted by Ui.dp with density and Math.round
units.policy: Keep native units. They are not CSS dimensions and should not be silently converted to web tokens.

colorResolution.policy: Strip the documentation suffix to identify the same Android resource name in values-night. The brand pair inherits from values in both themes.
colorResolution.ramps: No tonal ramps are authored in the app; none are synthesized as design tokens.

typographyBehavior.materialWidgets: MaterialButton and TextInputEditText do not use Ui.text; retain inherited native typography unless explicitly overridden.

layout.root: Vertical LinearLayout: top bar with logo/title, mode tabs, help, and day/night toggle; weighted ScrollView; footer outside the scroll area.

button.unoverriddenBehavior: Horizontal padding, ripple, pressed/focus behavior, and other Material style defaults are inherited.

disabled.state: ColorStateList uses -android.R.attr.state_enabled before the default enabled entry.

card.paddingOwnership: The route/form content supplies padding; Ui.card does not add it.

field.error: Native field error slot; clear the current field error on edit.
field.dates: Start and end open DatePickerDialog, followed by a MaterialAlertDialog with native hour/minute/second NumberPickers.

route.geometry: Actual selected KML route; centered with longitude corrected by cos(latitude).
route.accessibility: Route name, point count, and approximate length in the view content description.
route.mapContext: RoutePreviewView projects WGS84 KML points with Web Mercator, loads OpenStreetMap tiles asynchronously with attribution and cache, and falls back to a deterministic block/park/water canvas when tiles are unavailable. Keep record details → Fullscreen → Layers → tap the Street thumbnail → confirm remains the authoritative saved-record map.

historyReview.shape: Rectangular tonal inset; no custom corner drawable.
historyReview.state: Hidden until one record is prepared; edits invalidate it.
historyReview.totals: Natural and uniform modes preserve the requested duration, total distance, and average pace.
historyReview.coordinateBoundary: New Keep history handoffs adapt standard GPS/WGS84 route points to GCJ-02 through KeepCoordinates. GPX retains GPS coordinates. Existing cloud records are not rewritten, and alignment of a newly converted cloud record is not independently verified.
historyReview.sourceBadge: KeepRecordBuilder writes source=keep_app and source_page=keep_app in the detail payload; insertSql keeps sourceType=OFFLINE in the SQLite summary. Local parser and unit-test evidence do not establish cloud/list source-badge acceptance.

footer.activeRun: Show status, distance/time, progress, pause/resume, and end in either mode.
footer.historyDuringRun: Primary disabled and labeled 结束后补跑.
footer.idleHistory: Hide compact live status; use preview then explicit Keep handoff.
footer.accessibility: Status, footer error, and connection messages use polite live regions where declared in source.

timePicker.columns: Three equal-width columns labeled 时 / 分 / 秒
timePicker.contentDescriptions: Each picker uses its visible unit label.
timePicker.confirm: Clear each picker focus, then format the selected timestamp with seconds and no fractional seconds.
timePicker.savedValues: RunDateTime accepts uuuu-MM-dd HH:mm[:ss] and formats uuuu-MM-dd HH:mm:ss; prior minute-only values become :00.
timePicker.styling: Native widget text, wheel, and interaction behavior; dialog actions inherit accent theme roles.

paceSwitch.label: 自然配速
paceSwitch.savedState: Independent live_natural and history_natural preferences; default true.
paceSwitch.modes: Checked selects natural pace; unchecked selects uniform pace.
paceSwitch.live: Disabled while active or busy; live form displays current pace and speed during the run.
paceSwitch.history: Changing the switch invalidates the prepared review. Duration, total distance, and average pace stay tied to the requested inputs.
paceSwitch.explanation: Runs over 1 km start slightly faster, settle through the first kilometer, then retain small smooth changes.
paceSwitch.algorithm: PaceProfile combines interpolated low-frequency noise at 145 m and 330 m with a sine component (weights 0.58, 0.25, and 0.17). The amplitude coefficient is 0.020–0.030, the opening factor applies a smooth first-kilometer speed-up, and the integrated curve is normalized by its mean so requested duration, distance, and average pace remain fixed.
paceSwitch.algorithmAuthority: core/PaceProfile.java and README.md explain the algorithm; numerical coefficients are not visual tokens.
paceSwitch.styling: Track and thumb states remain native Material defaults.

native.componentSpecimenPolicy: The component html fields render native Java source specimens as text. They do not simulate Android controls, invent CSS interaction states, or claim browser/Android visual equivalence.

assetProvenance.jpeg: Recovered KmAo pixels retained; provenance embedded as a JPEG comment. Source and current hashes are in the manifest.
assetProvenance.webp: Existing launcher pixels retained; provenance in adjacent .webp.json sidecars.
assetProvenance.packaging: app/build.gradle.kts prepares a generated resource directory, excluding **/*.webp.json. Packaging validation is outside this design document.

providedScan.scope: Supplied refinement scan; no asset changes in this documentation pass.

reviewEvidence.scope: Authorized control-contrast, second-level selection, natural/uniform pace, map-help, and handoff refinements; the review validates two new 600x1100 captures plus the prior 14 refinement captures with no material fixes.
reviewEvidence.notEstablished: The supplied Keep evidence establishes layer recovery, not new converted cloud-record alignment, correction of existing cloud records, or cloud/list source-badge acceptance. This documentation pass performed no screenshot or device operations.

narrative.overview:
kegent is a compact native Android tool for configuring route playback and preparing one historical run. Its visual identity retains the installed KmAo light blue and original artwork, with ink-blue text, cool surfaces, and native Material controls. The app title is kegent; the package is `com.haven.kegent`. The dark page ground is `#121212`; the day/night capsule follows the supplied native Canvas specification.

The interface gives route geometry, editable parameters, and current run state clear roles. Clear control boundaries and quiet tonal panels organize a practical workspace. Motion explains a state change or progress update. Light and dark themes share the same blue family, and text uses Android's scalable native typography.
keyCharacteristics: Retained light-blue identity with cool neutral surfaces.
Native Material 3 controls and Android dp/sp units.
Actual route geometry paired with visible run status.
Compact forms, persistent actions, and restrained state motion.
One historical record with explicit preview and handoff states.

rules.name: The Blue Continuity Rule
rules.body: Use the existing blue and neutral resource roles in both themes. Do not introduce a green UI palette. The original artwork's grass pixels belong to the retained image, not to the control palette.

rules.name: The Resource Pair Rule
rules.body: Resolve colors through Android resources. Keep the shared brand pair stable and use the corresponding night overrides for surfaces, text, control states, accents, and errors.

rules.name: The Native Scale Rule
rules.body: Keep text in sp and geometry in dp. Preserve wrapping and the scrollable form when Android font scaling increases; do not compress the layout by fixing text heights.

rules.name: The Visible Run Rule
rules.body: Switching tabs must preserve the active run's status, distance/time, progress, and pause/resume/end controls. A blocked history action explains its state with “结束后补跑”.

rules.name: The Quiet Surface Rule
rules.body: Reuse surface tone and outlines to group workspace content. Keep cards flat at rest instead of adding decorative elevation.

dos: Do retain the existing blue brand pair, original artwork, and kegent identity.
Do resolve all theme colors through Android resources and their night overrides.
Do use native Material controls, dp geometry, sp text, and system font scaling.
Do keep active-run status and controls available when switching modes.
Do draw actual route geometry and cancel superseded motion.
Do honor system animation settings for reveals and progress.
Do label generated history, local preparation, and Keep handoff according to the actual state.
Do keep the Keep map help path explicit about tapping the Street thumbnail and confirming the layer.
Do preserve the distinction between detail source fields (keep_app) and the offline summary classification (OFFLINE).
Do retain raster provenance and use the provenance manifest when checking asset changes.
donts: Don't introduce a green UI palette or recolor the retained artwork to remove its original grass pixels.
Don't invent browser tokens, hover states, font families, or tonal scales for this native app.
Don't add decorative shadows to the flat workspace cards.
Don't hide an active run's controls behind a disabled history action.
Don't label a prepared or locally handed-off record as verified cloud success.
Don't infer cloud/list source-badge acceptance from local JSON or SQLite fields alone.
Don't treat provenance JSON sidecars as Android drawable or mipmap resources.
